Easy Does It Sunday Ride

Chico, CA · Bidwell Park · Road · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Easy Does It Sunday Ride is a road and social group ride in Chico, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 1:00 pm from Hooker Oak Park, center of the parking lot. About 12 miles, about 11 mph, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 1:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @northrimadventuresports the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Easy Does It Sunday Ride group ride

An easy no-drop ride from a Chico bike shop. About 12 miles at 11 mph on a mix of Bidwell Park, back roads and bike paths. Built for new riders and people getting back on the bike. Helmets required. The shop also runs a no-drop road ride Fridays at 9 am from One Mile.
